snippet.title: Season 4 Naval Gameplay Deep Dive | Battlefield 6
snippet.description:
Naval warfare returns to Battlefield 6 in Season 4.

Go inside Season 4 with the developers and discover how naval warfare returns to the front lines.

Deploy to Tsuru Reef, our biggest battlefield yet, where land, air, and sea collide in massive all-out warfare. Master the new Dynamic Wave System, command two new naval vehicles, expand your arsenal with five new weapons, and experience Battlefield's most ambitious naval combat yet.

Learn more about highly requested features, including Custom Lobbies, Spectator Mode, and additional Portal improvements, giving you more ways to play and create.

Then look ahead to the Top Gun update on August 18, featuring the return of Wake Island, new fighter jets, Carrier Strike, Gauntlet: Fighter Sweep, and new event rewards.

Battlefield 6 Season 4 launches July 21.
